title: fitfly-engine
description: Deterministic fitness coaching engine: adaptive programs, progression math, readiness autoregulation
summary: Deterministic fitness coaching engine: adaptive programs, progression math, readiness autoregulation
offersHint: Deterministic fitness coaching engine: adaptive programs, progression math, readiness autoregulation · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://workout-engine-production-5dd7.up.railway.app/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer fft_... personal access token. FitFly users mint one via POST /api/engine/me/mcp-token; coaches mint athlete tokens via the partner API. See /connect.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer fft_... personal access token. FitFly users mint one via POST /api/engine/me/mcp-token; coaches mint athlete tokens via the partner API. See /connect.

toolsPreview.name: get_todays_session
toolsPreview.description: Today's workout: exercises, sets/reps, per-exercise load guidance and concrete target weights, plus nutrition targets and cycle status. Auto-applies the user's readiness check-in (autoregulation) if they've done one today. Call this to see what the athlete should do now.

toolsPreview.name: readiness_checkin
toolsPreview.description: Record how the athlete feels today (energy, sleep, soreness — each 1–5). The engine scores readiness and, on the next get_todays_session, reshapes the workout accordingly (reduce volume / reduce intensity / recovery day). Returns the readiness score + modifier.

toolsPreview.name: log_workout
toolsPreview.description: Record what the athlete actually lifted. The engine runs progression (double-progression, e1RM), detects PRs, and returns per-exercise outcomes (established/progressed/held/deloaded) with next-time targets. Weights are in kg.

toolsPreview.name: list_swap_options
toolsPreview.description: Valid alternatives for an exercise — same muscle group, filtered to the athlete's equipment/level/injuries. Use before swap_exercise.

toolsPreview.name: swap_exercise
toolsPreview.description: Replace an exercise with a valid same-area alternative. scope 'today' = just this session; scope 'program' = going forward. The new lift starts fresh (day-one calibration).

toolsPreview.name: regenerate_program
toolsPreview.description: Rebuild the whole program from the stored profile (~20s AI generation). Use after a profile change or a plateau.

toolsPreview.name: nutrition_targets
toolsPreview.description: The athlete's daily calorie + macro targets, computed from body stats, activity, and goal.

toolsPreview.name: meal_plan
toolsPreview.description: A day of meals hitting the athlete's targets, USDA truth-checked (flags feasible=false with a note when macros are approximate). Slow (~15s AI call).

toolsPreview.name: changelog
toolsPreview.description: The 'what changed & why' feed — the engine's coaching decisions (volume bumps, deloads, swaps) in Coach Fly's voice. Use to explain to the athlete why their plan evolved.
